notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced: every magnitude in the shipped content carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them -- so this file is a measurement and not a balance claim.

The universe is still degenerate in the following ways, and one standing note is corrected here. The superseded files said the gate sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb; that is true of balance-gate-v1 and balance-gate-horizon-v1 and FALSE of this one, whose agentPool is the whole eight-strategy pool round-robin. W52 measured the proof: changing what encourageResearch does moved nothing in the other two gates and moved every metric here. Nothing in packages/scenario opens a portal, so no raid runs in any committed sweep and no summon is ever created. Scribing still stops when the materials stock empties. Teaching no longer dies out once the founding grants are taught -- over the reference two hundred years a lesson is taught in every one of the ten twenty-year windows, the thinnest holding 16.

What moved, measured against the superseded baseline before this file replaced it: balance-gate-v1 and balance-gate-horizon-v1 moved NO metric at all -- delta 0.00000 on all ten in each -- because neither sweep's strategies ever submit encourageResearch. balance-gate-ascension-v1, whose pool does, moved every metric inside 0.5 SE: referenceLivingMages +1.9375 (0.50 SE), referenceGrimoires +7.78125 (0.19 SE), referenceKnowledgeInstances +39.4063 (0.12 SE), referenceLibraryDepth -0.90625 (-0.27 SE), referenceNodesKnown -0.5625 (-0.05 SE), referenceNodesGained -0.5625 (-0.05 SE), referenceNodesGainedFinalQuarter -0.0625 (-0.04 SE), referencePopulation -186.531 (-0.15 SE), referencePopulationChange -186.531 (-0.15 SE), referencePeakPopulation 0.00000.
